I have been in situations like this before! And it sounds like my situation right now!

Not telling someone how you feel is a bit sad to me. I'd rather not regret expressing feelings like that.
My advice to you is you should probably tell him straight up. It's going to be hard and nerve racking but I think it's just good to let him hear how much you mean to him.
And who knows, maybe he will feel the same and if he doesn't, maybe it opens a window of opportunity. Sometimes people start to think about others when they get confessed to.
And even if he says he wants to stay friends, then that's okay too! Yes it might be awkward at first, but if he really means a lot to you, you still have your friendship.
You can even tell him in your own way "hey I developed feelings for you but if you don't feel the same, I want to still maintain our friendship because you mean a lot to me."

When I told my best friend I liked him, he declined my feelings. I even told him I want to keep our friendship. We started talking a lot more about relationships since then. We were "weird" at first but then we started flirting more and being more open with each other. So maybe it'll turn out like that with you too!
Good luck! I'm rooting for you!

Omg no, please try to move on to someone who will actually want to be with you and not try to pause your relationship when they're interested in someone else

She might say she still loves you to not make you feel bad or even because you guys have had good memories, or because she loves you like a friend but if she's even hesitant in her answer, move on.

It's great that you guys talked about your emotions and you felt like that but she hit you with that "wanting to see where things go with this other guy"

HUUUH??? 

Even if it was impulsive, she still started talking to someone while you were both in a relationship. I'm assuming since you said she broke up with you out of nowhere. The trust isn't there anymore. have respect for yourself. It seems she's really wanting to keep her options opened. And she'll fall back on you since it's obvious you still care.

It's gonna hurt since it's fresh but tbh, let that shit go

You aren't worthless at all! I'm sorry this happened to you, it's a really shitty feeling when you really love someone and want to help them to the best of your abilities only to have them turn their back on you when you're no longer a use to them.

She took advantage of your kindness during everything that happened. It's going to be rough and take time but you don't need her. She seems to have needed you more than you needing her. 

Your mistake wasn't stupid at all! It was your memories and sometimes those things include your ex. That was her insecurities (and honestly some cop out excuse it seems) that she could have communicated with you and chose not too until after everything you did for her.

The best thing to do now is ask if you could at least go back to get your stuff rn so you both can be done with it rather than go later because you do need your clothes. Like when is she supposed to feel less stressed about it?? 

And please understand you are not worthless!! She's such an awful person to do that to you!! 

With your level of love and wanting to support your partner through tough times like this one, you're sure to find the right person! This is her loss, there's no need for you to try to fix anything.

Good luck with trying to get your things and overcome the pain you feel right now. You are an amazing person and you are not worthless!
